In Panorama Ridge, Surrey, the 55+ homes you can buy are Lakewood Heights and Lakewood Place (strata). This page names each building, says what type it is and what the sources show, and covers local rules and the questions buyers ask. Anything no source states is marked unconfirmed.
55+ strata buildings you can buy in Panorama Ridge
Lakewood Heights — 6211 W Boundary Drive (Panorama Ridge)

Townhouse complex at Boundary Park. MLS listings place it in the Panorama Ridge sub-area and describe "a welcoming 55+ community, where only one occupant needs to meet the age requirement"; a listing for a 3-bed, 3-bath end unit records 2,230 sq ft and a 1990 build year for that unit. Total unit count: Not confirmed from non-directory sources checked — do not publish a count without the strata plan.
Lakewood Place — 6061 W Boundary Drive (Panorama Ridge)

Townhouse complex across from Boundary Park lake. MLS listings place it in the Panorama Ridge sub-area under the name Lakewood Place and describe an "END unit in 55+ community" / "Pride of ownership shines in this Lakewood Place townhome. END unit in triplex style. 55+ community." Total unit count and strata plan: Not confirmed from the sources checked.
Streets, schools and getting around Panorama Ridge

items.t: Panorama Ridge sits inside the City of Surrey's South Newton plan area in the Newton community: the plan area that contains it covers the lands north of Highway 10, east of King George Boulevard and west of 152 Street, with commercial nodes at Panorama Heights (152 St / Hwy 10) and Sullivan Heights (64 Ave / 144 St). No stand-alone City boundary for "Panorama Ridge" is published — not verified as an official line.
Nearby areas: Sullivan Station (north), East Newton (northwest), West Newton (west), and the Serpentine lowlands and Delta (south, across Highway 10).
The 55+ stock is not spread across the ridge: it clusters on W Boundary Drive at Boundary Park, at the sub-area's west edge, in the Lakewood Place and Lakewood Heights townhouse complexes.
SD36 schools in the area: Panorama Ridge Secondary, 13220 64 Ave; Colebrook Elementary, 5404 125a St; McLeod Road Traditional, 6325 142 St.

Transit: routes 321 (White Rock / Newton via 152 St and King George Blvd), 322 (Newton / Scottsdale via 132 St and 64 Ave) and 324 (Newton / Surrey Central via 132 St) run on the area grid, and the R1 RapidBus runs on King George Boulevard west of the area.
Main road corridors: King George Boulevard north to Surrey Central; Highway 10 east to Langley/Cloverdale and west toward Delta; 152 Street and 64 Avenue.
Health care: no hospital is inside the sub-area; Surrey Memorial Hospital, 13750 96 Ave, and the Surrey-Newton Urgent and Primary Care Centre, 6830 King George Blvd, serve the area.

Land caution that shapes this sub-area: the plan area includes fish-bearing creeks — Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek and Hyland Creek tributaries — so riparian setback rules can apply to creek-side lots, and the Serpentine lowlands lie south of Highway 10.

blocks.text: Local rules and plans in Panorama Ridge

items.t: City zoning: Surrey Zoning Bylaw No. 12000 governs the South Newton lands (R-series residential zones, with RA at the rural edges toward Colebrook). For Panorama Ridge, the R3 minimum subdivision lot area is 660 m² (Part 26 Section F of the bylaw).

Plans: the South Newton NCP no longer governs: A City update endorsed land-use and road-network changes for South Newton, and the South Newton NCP was then rescinded by the Surrey 2050 Official Community Plan update — land use now follows the OCP and Zoning Bylaw 12000.

Small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH): Surrey allows a maximum of 3 units on lots smaller than 280 m², 4 units on lots larger than 280 m², and up to 6 units on eligible lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent bus stop; one secondary suite per house under the BC Building Code. This affects the detached streets around the Boundary Park complexes, not the strata lots inside them.

Strata vs freehold in this sub-area: the verified base stock is predominantly freehold detached houses; the two verified 55+ complexes are strata townhouse product under the Strata Property Act, with monthly fees, levies and shared common-property obligations.
Property taxes (city-wide, not area-specific): City of Surrey property taxes are due July 2, with a 5% penalty if not paid by midnight July 2 and a further 5% penalty after September 2.

Good to know about Panorama Ridge

items.t: All of Panorama Ridge's verified 55+ ownership stock is on one short drive. Lakewood Place (6061) and Lakewood Heights (6211) on W Boundary Drive are the whole verified list — there is no 55+ condo tower, rental building or care residence inside the sub-area to fall back on if neither complex has a listing.

The same drive is split between two MLS sub-areas. Lakeview Estates at 6090 W Boundary Drive is filed under West Newton while its two neighbours are filed under Panorama Ridge — a buyer searching only one sub-area's 55+ page will miss a third of the Boundary Park cluster.

"Ideal place for seniors" in a listing is not an age bylaw. Panorama Mews (5867 129 St) uses that phrase for a main-floor-layout townhouse, but no source states an age restriction for the complex — only a filed 55+ bylaw (or an MLS restricted-age field) makes a complex 55+.

The sub-area's namesake care-sounding building is a recovery residence. Cedars at Panorama Ridge (6811 135A St) is class SU (supportive recovery) in the provincial Assisted Living Registry — Panorama Ridge has no registered seniors assisted-living residence of its own.

The governing plan changed under this sub-area. The South Newton NCP was rescinded by the Surrey 2050 OCP update, so a seller quoting South Newton NCP densities or designations is quoting a document that is no longer in effect; the OCP and Zoning Bylaw 12000 are the live sources.

The newest townhouse stock here is family product, not seniors product. Nora (12830 62 Ave, 2022) and Steller Panorama (5858 132 St, 2022) added 81 townhouses in 2022 with no age restriction found in any source — Panorama Ridge's 55+ supply is still the older Boundary Park complexes.

faq.q: What 55+ homes can I actually buy in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: Two strata townhouse complexes verified, both on W Boundary Drive at Boundary Park: Lakewood Heights (6211 W Boundary Drive) and Lakewood Place (6061 W Boundary Drive). No 55+ condo building, rental building, retirement residence or subsidized complex was verified inside the sub-area.

faq.q: Do both of us have to be 55?
faq.a: At Lakewood Heights, listings state only one occupant needs to meet the age requirement. Provincially, a younger spouse or partner of a resident who meets the age requirement (or holds a legacy exemption) is exempt in any case — confirm the complex's own bylaw wording in the Form B.

faq.q: Is Cedars at Panorama Ridge a seniors residence I can move into?
faq.a: No. BC's Assisted Living Registry records 6811 135A St as a supportive-recovery residence (class SU), not a seniors residence — the "Panorama Ridge" in its name is a location label, not a seniors-housing offer.

faq.q: Are these rancher-style homes, or will I have stairs?
faq.a: The verified Boundary Park product is two-storey townhouse form — the Lakewood Heights listing describes a 3-bed, 3-bath, 2,230 sq ft end unit, and the Lakewood Place listing describes a triplex-style end unit with three bedrooms up. A buyer who needs single-level living should verify the floor plan unit by unit; no verified single-level 55+ complex was found in this sub-area.

faq.q: What should I check on a Panorama Ridge lot or townhouse near the creeks?
faq.a: The plan area includes fish-bearing creeks (Archibald Creek headwaters, Sullivan Heights Creek, Hyland Creek tributaries), so riparian setback rules can limit building envelopes on creek-side lots — check City mapping and development permit areas before valuing an addition or rebuild.

faq.q: Where is the closest hospital and urgent care?
faq.a: Neither is inside the sub-area: Surrey Memorial Hospital is at 13750 96 Ave and the Surrey-Newton Urgent and Primary Care Centre is at 6830 King George Blvd.
